title: Open-Meteo Historical Weather API (reanalysis)
summary: Gridded modelled historical weather (reanalysis-based) served as JSON by the Open-Meteo Historical Weather API. Probed at a Milan-area point (45.46, 9.19), which the API snapped to grid cell 45.448154, 9.169279 at 138 m elevation. Hourly temperature_2m and relative_humidity_2m returned for both the prototype start (2004-03-10 to 2004-03-12) and the production end (2025-12-29 to 2025-12-31). It is a model grid product, not a station observation, and the free tier is licensed for non-commercial use only.

fields.name: time
fields.description: Hourly timestamps, returned in the requested timezone (UTC requested; response reports GMT, utc_offset_seconds 0)

fields.name: latitude/longitude/elevation
fields.description: Coordinates of the snapped grid cell and its elevation (returned in the response envelope, not per row)

schema.notes: Documented variable list on the docs page includes many more hourly variables (dewpoint, precipitation, wind, cloud cover, etc.); only the two probed variables were confirmed. Register default query uses temperature_2m and shortwave_radiation at Lisbon-like coordinates (45.46/9.19 is the probe location used here; the register default is 45.46, 9.19 for lat/long, not Lisbon as the candidate note states).

spatial.code_system: decimal-degree coordinates (lat/lon), snapped to a model grid cell
spatial.notes: Client location is not set by the register; the probes used 45.46, 9.19 (the register default_query value). The candidate note said the register default was Lisbon (38.72, -9.14); the register entry actually lists 45.46 / 9.19, so the note appears to be wrong. Either way, the location must be a recorded human assumption in decisions.md. Grid cell 45.448154/9.169279 is about 10 km resolution per the docs.

access.request_process: Free access without key via https://archive-api.open-meteo.com/v1/archive. Free tier limits: 10,000 calls/day, 5,000/hour, 600/minute. Production or any commercial use needs a paid subscription (Standard/Professional/Enterprise) per terms page; the Legal review in policy.open_data_links is needed before live production use. Size reported is for a 3-day probe (2.2 KB); full-window size not established.

documentation_excerpts: Gap-free and consistent historical weather data using weather reanalysis from ERA5 (0.25°, from 1940) and ERA5-Land (0.1°, from 1950) and ECMWF IFS (9 km, from 2017). (docs page, historical-weather-api)

quality_notes: Licence conflict: the register lists production as an approved purpose with agreement_status not_required_open_data, but the terms page limits the Free API to non-commercial use and states commercial use needs a paid subscription. The client is a public health office, and the terms give public institutions and non-profit use as non-commercial examples, but whether a live clinical warning service counts is not decided here. Treat production use as needing Legal review (policy.open_data_links says production use needs Legal sign-off).

Register default_query coordinates are 45.46 / 9.19 (Milan area) in the register entry, not Lisbon. The candidate note's Lisbon claim does not match the register text as read at 2026-10-15. Record both: candidate note says Lisbon (38.72, -9.14); register lists 45.46, 9.19.

Modelled reanalysis at about 10 km grid (ERA5-family or ECMWF IFS 9 km from 2017, per docs). Not station observation. Urban smoothing and cell-size representativeness vs. the city's monitoring stations must be assessed.
Time base: request was UTC; response reports timezone GMT with utc_offset_seconds 0. Air-quality and traffic sources must be aligned to this before joining.

Coverage probed only at the two ends of the prototype window (2004-03-10 to 2004-03-12) and the production window end (2025-12-29 to 2025-12-31). The 2004-04-04 end and 2024-01-01 start were not probed; full coverage of each window is therefore not confirmed.
Humidity: relative_humidity_2m (N3) returned for both probes. Dewpoint and other variables are documented but were not probed.
